newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto film festival announces planned offerings.
newsitem.headline: Toronto film festival announces planned offerings.

text.p: Toronto International Film Festival director Piers Handling said on Tuesday that Canadian director Atom Egoyan's Cannes award-winning film "The Sweet Hereafter" would open the prestigious festival on September 4.

Handling told a crowded news conference that the festival would also host the North American premiere of director Curtis Hanson's film noir "L.A. Confidential", which stars Kevin Spacey and Kim Basinger; the world premiere of "Mrs. Dalloway", starring Vanessa Redgrave from director Marleen Gorris; "Regeneration" by director Gillies MacKinnon; and the North American premiere of Vera Belmont's "Marquise".
"We'll be filling in the rest of the pieces in the coming weeks," Handling said. "(But) we're certainly thrilled and we think it is a good start."
He said the festival would feature French director Benoit Jacquot in its Spotlight program, including the North American premiere of Jacquot's most recent film "Le Septieme Ciel".
One change to the festival this year is the inclusion of the Masters program, which will highlight the work of acclaimed directors such as Jean-Luc Godard, Lars von Trier and Michelangelo Antonioni.
"These films are the highlights for many festival-goers, so we decided to make the Masters a program in its own right," Handling said.
